blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has asked to delay the increase of the passport fee until June 2028 when it begins issuing the next-generation Philippine passports. DFA Secretary Theresa Lazaro proposed the push back in response to government passport printer APO Production Unit’s request to increase the passport fee from P950 to P1,500 in January 2027. “Kung mag-i-increase kami, let’s say sa January, sa nire-request nila, eh paano ho ’yung next generation (passports)? Eh iba na ho ’yung papel… ’yun lang ang pakiusap namin sa kanila. Until mid-2028,” Lazaro said during the DFA’s budget hearing last Sept. […]...
